timer.name: rowswake
timer.description: Kodi never reloads a hidden list, and an empty row is hidden. When the helper bumps Widgets.Reload this runs for a second so rows count as visible (see widget_base_normal) and can fetch again, e.g. the Watch Later row after its first title is added.

timer.name: watchlaterbusy
timer.description: Runs from a Watch Later press until the helper has changed Trakt and the button's state list (5630) has reloaded, then lets the button take the next press. At least two seconds, so two changes never share a Trakt timestamp; eight at most, in case the helper never reports back.

timer.name: widgetsreload
timer.description: Copies the helper's Widgets.Reload counter into DeflixWidgetsReload, which every list except the watchlist ones uses in its address. A bump that arrives while a Watch Later press is in flight is not copied, so that press reloads only the watchlist lists.
